title: Runtime B: through the Airline Connector
lede: Meta’s Muse asks Muse through the Airline Connector. Same sign-in and delegation; Meta only ever holds a Muse token.

lanes.label: B. Through the Airline Connector: Meta's Muse asks Muse

nodes.label: 1. User asks in Meta's Muse
sub: "How many SkyHigh points do I have?"

nodes.label: 2. Meta's Muse picks the connector
sub: reads tool names and descriptions; the airline name in them decides

nodes.label: 3. /mcp answers 401
sub: with metadata: sign in at Muse's own authorize endpoint

nodes.label: 4. PingOne sign-in
sub: same DaVinci flow; login hint ends .conn

nodes.label: 6. Muse does the exchanges
sub: same agent token + 2 exchanges as part A

nodes.label: 7. Muse gives Meta its own token
sub: the PingOne token never leaves Muse

nodes.label: 8. Meta calls /mcp with it
sub: Muse calls the gateway for it

nodes.label: 9. Answer comes back
sub: points and tier, shown in Meta's Muse

steps.title: Ask
steps.what: The user asks in Meta’s Muse: "How many SkyHigh points do I have?"
steps.why: The user never leaves Meta’s Muse.

steps.title: Picks connector
steps.what: Meta’s Muse reads each connector’s tool names and descriptions and picks the one for the airline.
steps.why: The airline name in the descriptions tells two airline connectors apart.

steps.title: 401, sign in
steps.what: /mcp answers 401 with metadata pointing at Muse’s own authorize endpoint. Meta’s Muse sends the user to PingOne.

steps.title: Sign-in
steps.what: The same DaVinci flow runs. The login hint ends .conn, so its screens name the Airline Connector.
steps.why: Sam sees which connector is asking.

steps.title: Consent
steps.what: Sam allows the Airline Connector. PingOne returns a code to Muse.
steps.why: Consent names the connector, not just Muse.

steps.title: Exchanges
steps.what: Muse does the agent token and the two exchanges, as in path A.
steps.why: Authorize treats a connector call like any agent call.

steps.title: Muse token
steps.what: Muse gives Meta’s Muse its own token. The PingOne token never leaves Muse.
steps.why: Meta never holds a PingOne token.

steps.title: Answer
steps.what: Meta’s Muse calls /mcp. Muse calls the gateway with the delegated token and returns the points and tier.
steps.why: The answer comes back through the same checks as path A.
